title: Antes de la conquista
goal: Read how historians actually know what they know about the pre-Columbian world, from surviving Maya codices to modern LiDAR surveys.

items: Explain why only four original Maya codices survive today.
Name two kinds of sources historians use, such as indigenous chronicles and carved inscriptions.
Explain what LiDAR has revealed in the Petén and the Amazon.
Recognise why historians rarely have a single definitive proof.
Use formal connectors like 'a pesar de' and 'a raíz de' to weigh evidence.
